<!-- FORGE:INVESTIGATOR -->
## Investigation Report

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | CONFIRMED |
| Confidence | HIGH |
| Severity | HIGH |
| Task type | Bug fix |

### What Was Claimed

Issue #94 reports that a structurally valid required local verification policy can name `npm test` at a repository root that has no test script while the real command lives under a monorepo package. The failure is currently discovered only after implementation, and `/forge:init` must not generate an impossible local policy.

### What We Found

The frozen base already contains a safe `cwd` policy field and a static required-command preflight. `preflightRequiredVerificationCommands` resolves the configured directory inside the frozen worktree, checks executable availability, and verifies package-manager script names from `package.json` without executing repository code. `startIssue` invokes it before materializing agents or launching a writer and cleans up the prepared worktree when setup fails.

The remaining setup gap is in `/forge:init`: `configureForgePolicy` always serializes `verification.commands: {}`. It neither preserves valid tracked commands nor statically inspects available package manifests/scripts to select a runnable command. Re-running setup silently discards local checks, while an existing impossible required command is not surfaced during setup. The preflight error for a missing configured directory also lacks a concrete config or `/forge:init` remediation.

### Root Cause

Policy loading and runtime preflight have monorepo-aware directory support, but initialization has no repository-aware verification selection/validation boundary. Initialization overwrites the command map instead of retaining only statically runnable required commands or explicitly selecting CI-only verification. Error construction is inconsistent: all failures include a policy path, but missing-directory failures do not explain how to remediate them.

### Affected Files

| Path | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `src/ui/commands.ts` | `/forge:init` policy generation currently discards commands and never validates or discovers package scripts. |
| `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` | Owns static preflight and remediation diagnostics for command cwd, executables, and package scripts. |
| `src/core/policy.ts` | Defines and validates the repository-relative `verification.commands.*.cwd` contract. |
| `src/workflows/work-on.ts` | Calls preflight before writer launch; behavior must remain fail-closed. |
| `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` | Existing monorepo regression coverage; add setup/error coverage without executing repository commands. |
| `test/ui/commands.test.ts` | Existing command registration tests; add pure initialization-selection coverage if helpers are exposed. |
| `README.md` | Documents cwd and CI-only policy behavior; update only if initialization behavior changes materially. |

### Evidence

- `.forge/config.json` uses `verification.commands.check` with `argv: ["npm", "run", "check"]`, `cwd: "."`, and `required: true`.
- `src/core/policy.ts` rejects absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, NUL bytes, and normalized paths outside the repository.
- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` uses `realpath`, `stat`, and JSON parsing to check the selected package and script; no command is spawned.
- `src/workflows/work-on.ts` calls preflight after worktree preparation and before `materializeForgeAgents`/`spawnWorkOn`; its catch block removes an unlaunched worktree.
- `src/ui/commands.ts` currently assigns `commands: {}` while serializing the setup result, so a valid existing local command is lost on `/forge:init`.
- Existing tests prove the root-no-script/web-script fixture is rejected for `cwd: "."` and accepted for `cwd: "web"`.

### History Findings

Repository guidance requires deterministic, fail-closed verification and regression tests. README already documents `cwd` and `commands: {}` as CI-only verification, indicating the runtime contract was partially introduced before this issue was fully addressed. There is no `/forge:init` test or package-script discovery helper in the current test suite.

### Recommendation

Keep the current safe cwd and static preflight contract. Add a pure repository-aware initialization step that statically discovers package manifests/scripts, preserves valid configured commands, and otherwise writes an explicit empty command map with a clear CI-only notification/remediation rather than selecting `npm test` blindly. Centralize diagnostic text so missing executables, package directories, package manifests, and scripts all include the exact `.forge/config.json` command path and an actionable `/forge:init` or config fix. Add regression tests for root-without-test/web-with-test initialization and for each fail-closed diagnostic; do not execute package scripts during setup.

### Related Issues

- None identified in the local repository.

### Decomposition Assessment

Single bounded change. The policy, static preflight, initialization helper, tests, and documentation are tightly coupled and can be implemented by one writer without a product or authority decision.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] Required verification commands support a validated repository-relative `cwd` and preserve traversal/symlink/control-directory safety.
- [ ] `/forge:init` never selects a package-manager script unless the selected package manifest statically contains that script; valid existing commands remain intact.
- [ ] Initialization and work-on preflight inspect required executables, package directories, manifests, and package scripts without executing repository code.
- [ ] Failures identify the exact tracked config command path and concrete `/forge:init` or config remediation.
- [ ] A root-without-test/web-with-test fixture remains covered.
- [ ] Required checks that pass preflight still fail closed when execution later returns a non-zero result.
